idea-plugin.name: MASMLD RISC-V
idea-plugin.description:
RISC-V GNU assembly support for MASMLD, with RustRover as the primary tested product.

  • Syntax highlighting for instructions, pseudo instructions, registers, directives, labels, comments and strings.
  • Offline Chinese quick documentation for 181 instruction, register and directive names.
  • Navigate to labels, numeric local labels, constants, exported assembly symbols and same-file .macro definitions.
  • External source symbols use the host IDE indexes, including Rust and C/C++ when available.

Requires MASMLD Core. Select RISC-V under Settings → Languages & Frameworks → MASMLD Assembly. Enable quick documentation on hover in editor settings. No assembler, debugger, C++ demangler, macro expansion or RV32/RV64 legality checking is provided.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.7.0: First public release under the MIT license. Adds blue/purple modular cube branding and navigation from same-file macro calls and .purgem to .macro definitions. Includes assembly and linker-script highlighting, offline documentation, file icons and host source-symbol navigation.
